description: Semantic/AST-based prevention rules for TowerDefense01 — Go + Ebiten

rules.name: Hardcoded frame time literal in arithmetic
rules.message: Hardcoded 1.0/60.0 frame time — use ebiten.CurrentTPS() for actual frame rate

rules.name: Range over enemy slice in tower update
rules.message: Tower Update iterates all enemies with range — O(n*m) targeting without spatial partitioning
rules.suggestion: Use spatial grid: query only nearby cells instead of ranging all enemies

rules.name: Go: defer inside for loop
rules.message: defer inside loop — deferred calls pile up until function returns, leaking resources
rules.suggestion: Wrap loop body in an anonymous function: func() { defer cleanup(); ... }() or call .Close() directly

rules.name: Ebiten Update without delta time
rules.message: Game.Update() does not compute delta time — frame-rate dependent logic
rules.suggestion: Compute dt in Update: dt := 1.0 / float64(ebiten.CurrentTPS()); pass dt to all entity updates

rules.name: Go: Ignored error with blank identifier
rules.message: Error return value assigned to blank identifier — silently ignored
rules.suggestion: Check the error: if err != nil { log.Printf("error: %v", err); return err }

rules.name: Global var for game state instead of struct
rules.message: Global mutable variable for game state — should be encapsulated in Game struct
rules.suggestion: Move state into type Game struct {} and implement ebiten.Game interface
